findings.obs_text: In 1Ch 28:9 and Psa 139:23 the Lord searches the heart and knows the thoughts: searching is the way the thoughts are known. In Psa 10:4 the wicked does not seek God, and his thoughts deny him. In 2Sa 10:3 and 1Ch 19:3 the princes think David's servants came to search out the city, and in Joh 5:39 the hearers search the Scriptures because they think life is in them. In Mat 18:12 and Ecc 9:10 search and find stand in the case asked about and in the call to work while there is thought.
findings.grounds: Search me, O God, and know my heart

findings.obs_text: In Rom 12:3 one is to think of oneself with sober judgment, not more highly than one ought: the thinking is to be measured. In 2Cor 12:6 Paul refrains from boasting so that no one thinks more of him than is due.

In Num 33:56 the Lord will do to Israel as he thought to do to the nations: the thought is carried into deed. In Luk 12:17 the rich man thinks what to do with his crops, in 1Cor 7:36 the one who thinks he behaves badly toward his betrothed may do as he wishes, and in Ecc 9:10 the hand is to do with might while there is thought. In 1Ch 28:9 Solomon is to serve God with a willing mind, in Joh 16:2 the killer thinks he serves God, and in Phili 2:25 Paul thought it needful to send Epaphroditus his minister. In Eph 3:20 God does more than we think, and in Mar 12:14 the questioners speak of Jesus' way.
findings.grounds: I will do to you as I thought to do to them
